audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows disagree with the packet chart and with the content layer's own whys[]. Both layers render Aurora winning Levels 2-3, first item and 2+ items, while whys[1] says 'you start nudging the lane', whys[2] 'out-trades her poke', whys[3] 'you farm safely and win short trades', whys[4] 'beats her E escape', whys[6] 'reclaims the late game'. The mirror graded the lane TRICKY 7/10 from Aurora's side, which inverts to a favoured Neeko lane, and the win rate is 66.67%.
audit.why: The page currently tells a Neeko player she loses most of a lane her own text describes her winning.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Neeko / Neeko / Neeko / Neeko / Skill / Neeko as matched full/content pairs; diff FAV, diffRating 4/10 (inverse of the mirror's 7/10), carryRating 5/10, tone to the favourable colour, difficulty lines rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[1] through phases[6] carried boilerplate naming no Aurora ability, and phases[5] described a 'Stormsurge spike' that the content layer does not build toward.
audit.why: The real spike order is: your level 3 root window, your level 6 Pop Blossom, then her first-item poke range as the one danger window.
audit.corrected: All six rewritten on Twofold Hex, The Weirding, Across the Veil and the hidden Pop Blossom preparation.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4], spikes[1], mid and wants.you[1] all tell you to 'pop W (Shapesplitter) for invisibility', and late says you have nothing 'until W and your shields are back'. Neeko's W sends a redirectable clone — no invisibility — and she has no shield anywhere in her kit. The invisibility in this matchup belongs to Aurora's Across the Veil.
audit.why: The mechanic that actually makes the level-6 play work is Inherent Glamour: Riot's text says Pop Blossom's preparation is hidden while Neeko is disguised. That is the real reason the stun lands before she hops.
audit.corrected: Every invisibility/shield claim replaced with the disguise and the hidden preparation; dontsFull[0].d now states Spirit Abjuration healing her off every spell she lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d offered a 'fifteen-second invitation' after Across the Veil.
audit.why: Across the Veil is 22/21/20/19/18s — the rank-1 window is 22 seconds, not fifteen.
audit.corrected: Real number written into dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal anywhere, against a passive that heals her from every spell and attack she lands.
audit.why: Grievous Wounds timing decides the extended trades here.

edits.before: This is your lane. Through 4-5 you farm with Q and chip her with the second bloom, but the real spike is 6 — Pop Blossom. Set it up dirty: pop W (Shapesplitter) for invisibility or wear an allied disguise, walk into range unseen, then E to root and slam down the AoE stun before her E-blink can react, and a full Q combo on a squishy Aurora is a kill or a flash. Hold E until you actually see her commit her blink or W exile; the whole lane is winning that one telegraph exchange.
edits.after: This is your lane. Through 4-5 you farm with Q and chip her with the second bloom, but the real spike is 6 — Pop Blossom. Set it up dirty: wear an allied disguise, because Inherent Glamour hides the preparation entirely, walk into range unseen, then E to root and slam the AoE stun before she can hop, and a full Q combo on a squishy Aurora is a kill or a flash. Hold E until you actually see her commit Across the Veil or The Weirding; the whole lane is winning that one exchange.

edits.before: You out-scale this specific lane because she stays squishy and you become a clustered-fight bomb — a clean E into Pop Blossom in a grouped fight wins it outright. The thing to respect is her first-item poke: don't stand in her Q pulse and W exile for free, or she resets every trade from range. If she kites your single rotation you have nothing left until W and your shields are back, so always lead with E, ult unseen, and convert before the fight scatters.
edits.after: You out-scale this specific lane because she stays squishy and you become a clustered-fight bomb — a clean E into Pop Blossom in a grouped fight wins it outright. The thing to respect is her first-item poke: don't stand in Twofold Hex and The Weirding for free, or she resets every trade from range. If she kites your single rotation you have nothing until E is back at 12 seconds, so always lead with E, ult disguised, and convert before the fight scatters.

notes: Same Shapesplitter-invisibility fabrication as aatrox/akali/akshan/ambessa, and here it had also grown a phantom shield ('until W and your shields are back'). Neeko has neither. Six of seven chart rows were wrong in BOTH layers simultaneously, so they agreed with each other while contradicting the packet, the win rate, the whys[] and the mirror's inverse grade. tone was proposed as the favourable colour to match the FAV regrade; drop that one edit if the palette maps differently. Sample is thin (15 games on the packet), so the FAV / 4-10 regrade is Medium confidence and rests on the chart, the prose and the mirror rather than the win rate.
